patterns: Shared Hifa Store card for browser tools, Desktop apps and published community apps.

decisions: Hifa Store uses StoreAppCard for every entry: 164px cover, 16px body padding, 32px icon/title row, 40px two-line description, 32px footer action, 10px internal gaps, 20px grid gaps and 14px corners. Secondary community actions use the existing dropdown primitive. Keep original artwork and semantic Agent tokens.

Estudio IA is a regular Hifa Store card using StoreAppCard and its own artwork. The Store toolbar has only Crear app. The studio uses a short introduction, format shortcuts and existing explicit price confirmation; hide recharge when its catalog is unavailable.
